required_fixes: R1 — apps/desktop/src/v2/harness/harness.tsx:233-251 resets the used-entry set on every render. Two unconfirmed submissions of identical text to the same conversation, both made before another operator entry is observed, therefore consume the same eventual transcript entry across successive renders. Independently reproduced with the production Harness/store in jsdom: two explicit sends returned unknown and produced two records; publishing one matching operator entry removed both records and the Not confirmed region. The first effect drops one record, the resulting store render resets used, and the remaining record consumes that same entry. This erases uncertainty without evidence that both submissions arrived. Acceptance: reconcile each observed delivery at most once across renders and remounts, retain unresolved submissions conservatively, and add a regression where two same-conversation unknown sends receive only one matching transcript entry; one unresolved record must remain through further renders. Preserve the existing cross-conversation, older-entry and observation-before-receipt regressions.
